configuration.boundaryConvention: ALL bins [0.61,0.80) linear; [0.80,2.00) no smooth; TOF bins [2.00,5.00) linear, boundary point R=2 has zero measure; no gaps or duplication
configuration.calibrationWeight: equal residual in original sigma; no purity maximization
configuration.errorPolicy: Conditional yield error only; excludes shape, calibration and model uncertainty
configuration.targetShapePolicy: He4 mean and sigma free in all regions; low-R He3 center retains user calibration and sigma free below 0.70; no He4 mean fixed
configuration.pidPolicy: Git cubic mean and quadratic sigma for all; only He4 coefficients change, d/t/He3 and their validity domains exactly Git; He4 strict R>0.61
configuration.highPolicy: He4 Gaussian plus nonnegative linear continuum only; other nuclear amplitudes disabled, not fitted or counted as contamination; does not establish physical absence of those nuclei
